run_ml_nms: run non-maximum suppression on a boxlist with a specified IoU threshold
test_ml_nms: test ml_nms with a boxlist containing pred_boxes and pred_classes fields
refactor_ml_nms: refactor ml_nms to cap results with max_proposals after suppression
review_ml_nms: review ml_nms which uses detectron2 batched_nms for multi-label NMS
summarize_ml_nms: summarize ml_nms that filters overlapping boxes by score and label using batched NMS
